findings.evidence: Finding ID: map-registration-positive-control-gap. Severity: major. Location: registered m5-foundations-packet, map-area-create-control/candidate/docs/project-map.md lines61–65 and candidate/docs/project-map/importer.md; inherited by map-registration-interrupted, map-exact-registration-retry and map-registration-idempotent. The new importer row is separated from the normative Area maps table by a blank line, so it is ordinary text rather than a registration row in that table. The transaction says the importer links to storage with storage detail owned there, but the actual importer map has no storage-map link or overlap ownership statement and repeats the same Store detail. The canonical maintenance reference requires table-owned registration plus explicit overlap/detail ownership and cross-link, and MAP-registration requires a valid final reciprocal pair. Therefore claimed clean completion/idempotent success are not valid positive controls, even though intended hashes and partial byte effects match.

Have the author supply a complete compliant root/area positive control: insert the exact new row inside the existing registration table, preserve the storage row/map, and make actual overlap ownership and the link to sibling detail explicit in the area artifact without duplicating owned detail. Regenerate the retained transaction identities and every affected interruption/retry/negative variant consistently; keep one defining fault distinct from the valid control and record the correction under a new exact evidence subject. Independent review must reassess final reciprocal content, ordered action/identity checks and preserved neighbors. An explicit honest allocation gap disposition is an alternative if the owning plan authority chooses it. No canonical behavior, runtime validator or catalog change is required.
